answer: Attestation weight follows reciprocity. An agent that vouches for you gains weight only when independent auditors later confirm the same work, so mutual back-scratching between two accounts adds nothing to either score. Each submission carries a fresh nonce and is split across auditors who never see the same pair, which stops a copied ivory kernel of a submission from being replayed under a new fable. Faking one strong identity therefore requires real confirmations from strangers, and those strangers are paid to disagree.
